observations: Photo 0 shows a Hisense monitor displaying a trading dashboard interface with the Hisense logo visible at the bottom center of the bezel.
Photo 1 shows the same monitor from a slightly different angle, with the Hisense logo again visible at the bottom center of the bezel.
The screen is on and displaying content clearly, indicating the monitor is powered and functional at the time of the photo.
No visible damage to the screen or bezel is apparent in either photo.
The monitor is placed on a desk with cables visible, but no accessories, box, or receipt are shown in the photos.
The seller claims the monitor is 6 months used and includes receipt, carton, and accessories, but none are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: No serial number, production date, or warranty info visible. Age cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

claims.claim: receipt and carton and accessories all included
claims.evidence: No receipt, box, or accessories are visible in the photos. Seller's claim cannot be confirmed.

risks.risk: Monitor may have hidden screen defects (dead pixels, burn-in, backlight issues) not visible in the current display.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the monitor displaying a solid white screen, then solid black, then a color checker pattern, to reveal any defects.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially defective, with reduced value for possible hidden screen issues.

risks.risk: Accessories, receipt, and carton may not be included as claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the receipt, the original carton, and all accessories (cables, power adapter, etc.) laid out together.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as missing accessories, which reduces value significantly for a buyer expecting full package.

risks.risk: Monitor may have physical damage not visible in the photos (e.g., cracked stand, internal damage).
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the stand and back of the monitor, including any ports or hinges.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, with reduced value for possible unseen structural issues.

proof_requests: Photo of the receipt and original carton.
Photo of all accessories included (cables, power adapter, etc.).
Video clip showing the monitor displaying solid white, solid black, and color checker patterns.
Close-up photo of the back and stand of the monitor.
response.reason: The monitor is identifiable as a Hisense brand, and it appears to be functional based on the screen display. However, the seller's claims about age, included accessories, receipt, and carton cannot be verified from the current photos. Hidden risks such as screen defects and missing items affect pricing. Proof is needed to confirm the claims and assess the true condition and completeness of the item.
